title: New ransomware campaign targeting cloud infrastructure
description: Security researchers have identified a new ransomware variant specifically designed to target cloud-based infrastructure. The campaign uses compromised CI/CD pipelines to deploy malicious code.

title: Show HN: Open-source vulnerability scanner
description: New tool automatically scans dependencies for known vulnerabilities and suggests patches. Gaining traction in the security community.

title: Padloc 4.0.0 before 4.3.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the legacy...
description: Padloc 4.0.0 before 4.3.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the legacy retrieveMFAToken handler that never counts wrong email verification codes toward the attempt limit. Unauthenticated attackers knowing a victim's email can brute force the 6-digit code to obtain verification tokens usable in signup, login and account recovery flows.

title: Semantic MediaWiki 2.4.0 before 7.4.1 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in...
description: Semantic MediaWiki 2.4.0 before 7.4.1 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in TimeValueFormatter::getCaptionFromFreeFormat(), which emits free-format date captions in HTML without escaping. Unauthenticated attackers can craft a Special:Ask URL with HTML markup in a date printout format (#-F[...]) to execute script in a logged-in victim's browser session.

title: Semantic MediaWiki 3.0.0 before 7.4.1 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the...
description: Semantic MediaWiki 3.0.0 before 7.4.1 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the ElasticStore and SPARQLStore ConceptDescriptionInterpreter classes, which re-expand concepts without memoization or an expansion budget. Users with page-edit rights can build acyclic chains of Concept: pages that fan out, so queries via concept page views, Special:Ask, or api.php action=ask exhaust CPU and memory.

title: Semantic MediaWiki 2.5.0 before 7.4.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in...
description: Semantic MediaWiki 2.5.0 before 7.4.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ValueFormatter::getFormattedSubject() that renders property label segments after a literal   as unescaped markup. Users with page-edit rights can set a preferred property label containing an img onerror payload that executes when anyone, including administrators, views Special:Browse or the smwbrowse API.

title: Semantic MediaWiki 3.0.0 before 7.4.1 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in the...
description: Semantic MediaWiki 3.0.0 before 7.4.1 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in the ElasticStore ConceptDescriptionInterpreter that only detects directly self-referencing concepts. Users with page-edit rights can create mutually referencing concept pages, causing concept page views, Special:Ask, or api.php action=ask queries to exhaust PHP memory or stack.

title: Padloc 4.0.0 before 4.3.1 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows SCIM token...
description: Padloc 4.0.0 before 4.3.1 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows SCIM token holders to modify Object.prototype by sending crafted SCIM PATCH paths to ScimServer._handleScimUsersPatch(). Attackers can supply paths like __proto__.x or constructor.prototype.x passed to setPath() to pollute the shared server process, disrupting requests for all other organizations.

title: Semantic MediaWiki 7.3.1 before 7.4.1 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in...
description: Semantic MediaWiki 7.3.1 before 7.4.1 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in EditProtectionUpdater::userMayChangeProtection() that checks protection changes against the page's latest revision author. Editors can add {{#set:Is edit protected=false}} to a transcluded template, removing administrator edit and move protection logged under the administrator's name.

title: Mbin 1.2.1 before 1.11.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in EmbedElement:...
description: Mbin 1.2.1 before 1.11.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in EmbedElement::buildDestructed() that renders nested Markdown image alt text and URL without HTML escaping. Authenticated users can embed HTML in the alt text of an image inside a link in entries, comments, posts, messages, or bios to run script in viewers' browsers.

title: Semantic MediaWiki 3.0.0 before 7.4.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in...
description: Semantic MediaWiki 3.0.0 before 7.4.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Special:Ask with the ElasticStore backend, allowing users with edit rights to inject script through unescaped native_result and score_set output. Attackers can store markup in a Text property or subobject name, then lure victims including administrators to a crafted Special:Ask link to execute script in their session.

title: WWBN AVideo through 29.7.1 contains an improper payment verification vulnerability in plugin...
description: WWBN AVideo through 29.7.1 contains an improper payment verification vulnerability in plugin/PayPalYPT/ipnV2.php that credits wallets from PayPal IPNs not bound to the site's merchant account. Unauthenticated attackers can forward genuine VERIFIED recurring-payment IPNs from their own PayPal account with a chosen users_id to add wallet balance each billing cycle.

title: Semantic MediaWiki 2.5.0 before 7.4.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows...
description: Semantic MediaWiki 2.5.0 before 7.4.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows editors without the edit-protection right to lock pages by adding an Is edit protected annotation. Attackers can add [[Is edit protected::true]] to pages or #set it in widely transcluded templates, so the TitleQuickPermissions hook blocks other editors and administrators from editing, moving or deleting them indefinitely.

title: Semantic MediaWiki 3.0.0 before 7.4.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the...
description: Semantic MediaWiki 3.0.0 before 7.4.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the DataTables integration that initialises author-written smw-datatable tables unchanged. Users with page-edit rights can add HTML entity-encoded markup in data-search or data-filter cell attributes, executing script in viewers' browsers including administrators.

title: Semantic MediaWiki 4.2.0 before 7.4.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in...
description: Semantic MediaWiki 4.2.0 before 7.4.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in OptionsBuilder::profiles() that allows users with the smw-schemaedit right to inject markup. Attackers can save FACETEDSEARCH_PROFILE_SCHEMA profile keys or labels that break out of option elements, executing scripts for every Special:FacetedSearch visitor including administrators.

title: Directus before 12.1.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated...
description: Directus before 12.1.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to skip permission checks by sending a failed auth message on public-mode WebSocket connections. Attackers can send an invalid token so handleAuthRequest sets accountability to null, then read, create, update or delete records in any user-defined collection.

title: LimeSurvey Community Edition 7.8.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the survey-archive...
description: LimeSurvey Community Edition 7.8.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the survey-archive participant import and SPSS-response export workflow. An authenticated user with global surveys.create permission can import a crafted .lsa archive whose participant XML creates an attacker-named attribute column. When the user exports responses from the imported non-anonymous survey, LimeSurvey passes the persisted name to Yii's select builder. Names containing parentheses are treated as SQL express

title: WWBN AVideo through 29.7.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in API::get_api_tags()...
description: WWBN AVideo through 29.7.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in API::get_api_tags() in plugin/API/API.php that allows registered users to access restricted video data by querying the tags API. Attackers can subscribe to a tag and query APIName=tags to obtain filenames, titles and stored video_password values of unlisted, group-restricted and password-protected videos, enabling unauthorized viewing.

title: WWBN AVideo 6.5 through 29.7.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows...
description: WWBN AVideo 6.5 through 29.7.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to log in as any user via Hybridauth social login display names. Attackers can set their X, Facebook, Yahoo or LinkedIn display name to a victim's username and withhold email, causing login.json.php or oauth2.php to log them in as that account, including administrators, without a password.

title: Viber for iOS through 29.4.0.24 fails to validate the logical screen width and height in received...
description: Viber for iOS through 29.4.0.24 fails to validate the logical screen width and height in received GIF headers, allowing attackers to crash the app. Attackers can send a crafted GIF with zero dimensions that triggers an uncaught NSInternalInconsistencyException, aborting the app with SIGABRT when opened.

title: WWBN AVideo through 29.7.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in Live plugin restream...
description: WWBN AVideo through 29.7.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in Live plugin restream endpoints that allows authenticated streamers to obtain other users' stream keys by supplying arbitrary live_transmitions_history_id values. Attackers can redeem the issued action tokens at verifyTokenForAction.json.php to retrieve victims' HLS URLs and stream keys, then publish as the victim or restream private or pay-per-view lives.

title: WWBN AVideo 6.5 through 29.7.1 contains an email verification bypass vulnerability in User:...
description: WWBN AVideo 6.5 through 29.7.1 contains an email verification bypass vulnerability in User::verifyCode() in objects/user.php caused by PHP loose comparison of the recoverPass token. Registered users can reuse the installation-wide salt from their own verification link and craft a code with arbitrary users_id and recoverPass set to true to verify other accounts' emails, unlocking features such as live streaming.

title: CVE-2026-120635 - CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl allow form fields to be smuggled past proxies and WAFs via multipa
description:
CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl allow form fields to be smuggled past proxies and WAFs via multipart parsing that differs from the RFCs.

The multipart/form-data parser matches the boundary anywhere rather than at the start of a line, uses the boundary without its leading -- for some client-supplied User-Agent values, finds the Content-Disposition name and filename inside the quoted values of other parameters, and corrupts parts when the boundary nears the 4096-byte read size.

title: CVE-2026-120634 - CGI::Carp versions before 5.00 for Perl leak warnings across requests in persistent environments via
description:
CGI::Carp versions before 5.00 for Perl leak warnings across requests in persistent environments via the warningsToBrowser buffer.

Warnings are held in a package-level buffer until warningsToBrowser writes them into the page as HTML comments, and the buffer is never cleared between requests. Under mod_perl, FastCGI or PSGI, warnings from one request are written into a later one.

Warnings that contain one user's request data can appear in the HTML sent to another user.

title: CVE-2026-120633 - CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl trust the client X-Forwarded-Host header in url, self_url, virtual
description:
CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl trust the client X-Forwarded-Host header in url, self_url, virtual_host and virtual_port.

These take the host name and port from the X-Forwarded-Host request header when present, and otherwise from Host, without validating either. The URLs from url and self_url are the default redirect location and the start_html(-base=>1) base href, and the default start_form action when REQUEST_URI is not set.

A client can poison shared caches, and URLs the application stores or sends, with redirects, links and scripts that point at a host it controls.

title: CVE-2026-120632 - CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via a backtracking regex on the XForms multip
description:
CGI versions before 5.00 for Perl allow CPU exhaustion via a backtracking regex on the XForms multipart/related Content-Type.

When a POST Content-Type contains multipart/related, the boundary and start parameters are extracted with an unanchored pattern that puts .+ on either side of the boundary capture, which backtracks in cubic time on a header that does not match. No request body is needed.

title: CVE-2026-120631 - CGI::Cookie versions from 4.67 before 5.00 for Perl allow denial of service via the client cookie ex
description:
CGI::Cookie versions from 4.67 before 5.00 for Perl allow denial of service via the client cookie expires value used as a regex in parse.

CGI's cookie method reads the Cookie request header through parse, which interpolates the header's expires value unescaped into the substitution pattern that removes it from the cookie string.

A client can make the request die with an invalid pattern, or tie up the process with one that backtracks catastrophically.

title: CVE-2026-118628 - MLflow get-artifacts Server-Side Request Forgery Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerab
description:
MLflow get-artifacts Server-Side Request Forgery Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of MLflow. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the get-artifacts function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a URI prior to accessing resources. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of the server. Was ZDI-CAN-28192.

title: CVE-2026-118627 - MLflow SHAP load_explainer Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. Th
description:
MLflow SHAP load_explainer Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of MLflow. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.

The specific flaw exists within the loading of SHAP explainer models. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user. Was ZDI-CAN-30301.

title: CVE-2026-118626 - MLflow Tracking Server Issues Missing Authorization Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnera
description:
MLflow Tracking Server Issues Missing Authorization Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of MLflow. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the configuration of the BEFORE_REQUEST_HANDLERS. The issue results from the lack of authorization prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges to resources normally protected from the user. Was ZDI-CAN-32108.

description:
MailEnable Auth Cleartext Storage Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of MailEnable. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the handling of mailbox credentials. The issue results from storing sensitive information in plaintext. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise. Was ZDI-CAN-34478.

title: CVE-2026-114550 - libwebsockets MQTT Protocol PUBACK Packet Handling Out-Of-Bounds Write Remote Code Execution Vulnera
description:
libwebsockets MQTT Protocol PUBACK Packet Handling Out-Of-Bounds Write Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of libwebsockets. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the handling of PUBACK packets. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in a write past the end of an allocated buffer. title: CVE-2026-114549 - NoMachine nxwebrunner Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerabi
description:
NoMachine nxwebrunner Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of NoMachine. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the web service, which listens on TCP port 4443 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-30685.
